correctness.rationale: The exact ten-vertex fifteen-edge pentagonal prism defines 342 augmented matching faces with face vector (15,75,145,95,11). Reconstructed its pivot order and 168 acyclic pairings on 341 nonempty simplices, verified complete 1020-incidence directed Hasse acyclicity. Only one critical vertex, two critical 2-cells, two critical 3-cells remain. Exact integer gradient projection gives zero 2x2 three-to-two boundary, so pi2 of the simply connected wedge two S2 identifies both attaching maps as null. The finite Morse CW model therefore is exactly two S2 wedge two S3, not just mod-p Betti counts.

value.rationale: This is the smallest odd circular ladder after trivial triangle boundary, and Agarwal-Basak explicitly pose ordinary (as distinct from perfect) matching complexes of circular ladders as future work. The mixed-dimensional exact integral answer for C5 is a meaningful natural boundary case and compares sharply with its contractible perfect matching subcomplex.
